version:    2.1.1

changelog:
  2.1.1   2026-09-15  patch        Fixed Style=centered — its .headline/.body text nodes lost componentPropertyReferences during clone (Figma clone() doesn't reliably preserve text-property bindings), so setting Headline/Body via properties updated metadata but not the rendered text. Re-linked both to Headline#9554:0 / Body#9554:2.
  2.1.0   2026-09-15  minor        Added Style=centered variant — center-aligned headline/body text and centered CTA, for use in Bento tiles that need center-orientation copy (matches the Playground mockup reference). Non-breaking, additive.
  2.0.0   2026-08-04  init         Initial release

Text-only news / content card. Headline, optional body copy, and inline read-more CTA. No media. Use in 3-up news grids on light surfaces.
